response.sql:
WITH channel_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase AS channel,
  avg_filled_quantity,
  distinct_order_count,
  distinct_order_count::numeric
    / NULLIF(SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER (), 0) AS order_count_fraction
FROM channel_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A missing orderbase is represented by SQL NULL and forms its own group; the fraction denominator sums the per-channel distinct order counts, so an order with executions in multiple channels is counted in each such channel.
